name: Hill Top Summer Camps
description_short: Summer programs for neurodiverse kids and teens at Hill Top Preparatory School. Summer Adventures (entering grades 2 to 9) rotates campers through art, STEM, cooking, sports and swimming with social skills practice and Friday trips; teens can choose an esports program or Pathways to Independence for life and work skills.
special_needs_notes: Built for neurodiverse learners with a 5 to 1 camper to staff ratio. Campers need to communicate verbally and handle their own hygiene and bathroom needs. Non Hill Top families start with an inquiry, a tour and an interview to check fit. Many campers use Extended School Year funding through their district.
swim_waterfront_notes: Summer Adventures swims Monday to Thursday: 30 minutes of lessons, then 30 minutes of free swim.
notes: 2026 tuition: Summer Adventures $1,000 a week or $6,000 for six weeks; Pathways to Independence (entering 10th grade through the summer after senior year) $1,150 a week or $6,900; Esports and Technology (entering grades 6 to 12) $945 a week or $5,670. Camp 9:00 to 3:15; early care from 8:00 for a fee; no after care. Campers bring lunch. A two week PEERS social skills group is offered to middle schoolers for an added fee. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.
